note.overview: The model considers the effects of strategic inventory (SI) in the presence of chain-to-chain competition in a two-period model. Established findings suggest that SI may alleviate double marginalization and improve the efficiency of a decentralized distribution channel. However, no studies consider the role of SI under chain-to-chain competition.
